type DirectParam<U extends Parameters<(x: U & string) => void>[0]> = U;
type WrappedParam<U extends Array<Parameters<(x: U & string) => void>[0]>> = U;
type WrappedKey<U extends Array<Parameters<(x: keyof (U & string)) => void>[0]>> = U;
type WrappedReturn<U extends Array<ReturnType<() => keyof (U & string)>>> = U;
type ParameterKey<U extends Parameters<(x: keyof (U & string)) => void>[0]> = U;
type Signature<U extends (x: Uppercase<U>) => void> = U;
